subject: Post-demo: security & privacy pathing — DPA module options and SOC 2 timeline
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Dane Meyer <dane.meyer@meadowbank.com>, security@meadowbank.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo: security & privacy pathing — DPA module options and SOC 2 timeline

Hi Dane / MeadowBank security team —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary from demo:
- Product scope: real-time inference for transaction-risk scoring (low-latency, <150ms p95 objective).
- Data flow: encrypted in transit, tokens persisted only if configured.

Security & compliance items discussed:
1) SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security) in Q2 2026; we can share the report under NDA. Timeline: once NDA is in place we can deliver a redactable copy within 1–2 business days.
2) GDPR / DPA & SCC module: we support both controller-controller and controller-processor paths. For financial institutions we typically propose module C (controller-controller) when the customer prefers more control over downstream processing; module B is also used when the vendor needs to operate as processor.
3) Vendor security questionnaire: attached a short questionnaire (redwood_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf) to speed intake.

Asks / proposed next steps:
- Can you confirm MeadowBank’s preferred data role for this integration (controller or processor)? That determines the DPA module we propose.
- If helpful, tell us whether you prefer SCC Module B or C and we can prepare the drafter-friendly DPA (sample attached: redwood_sample_dpa_v2.docx).
- Please confirm the NDA path so we can send the SOC 2 report.
- Would you like a focused 30-min follow-up with our legal + security engineers to walk the questionnaire and SCC implications? I proposed Tue/Wed next week — we can book based on your availability.

Attachments referenced: redwood_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf, redwood_sample_dpa_v2.docx, SOC2-report-stub.pdf (SOC 2 will be shared after NDA).

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internal legal once you confirm the data-role preference.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Dane Meyer <dane.meyer@meadowbank.com>

Cc: Allison Park <allison.park@meadowbank.com>; security@meadowbank.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 20:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security & privacy pathing — DPA module options and SOC 2 timeline

Jonas —

Appreciate the recap. A couple of quick answers from our side:
- MeadowBank intends to act as controller for customer transaction metadata; Redwood would be a processor for the service.
- Given that, leaning toward SCC Module B makes sense to us but we need to confirm with procurement and legal.
- Please go ahead and share the sample DPA and the questionnaire; we’ll start internal review.

Two asks from MeadowBank:
1) Can you highlight any modules/clauses in your sample DPA that assume data-sharing with third-party analytics providers? We need to see optional clauses to turn off that behavior.
2) SOC 2: we can sign a mutual NDA. If you can send the NDA template or link, procurement will route it.

We’ll aim to get a decision on Module B vs C by COB Mon (23 Nov) — I’ll loop Allison & procurement if we need more time.

Thanks,
Dane
Dane Meyer | Head of Data Platforms
MeadowBank
dane.meyer@meadowbank.com

Hi Dane —

Thanks for the quick reply and helpful direction. A few clarifications inline: 

> MeadowBank intends to act as controller for customer transaction metadata; Redwood would be a processor for the service.

Great — that preference points us to prepare the DPA in a processor role configuration and default to SCC Module B.

> Can you highlight any modules/clauses in your sample DPA that assume data-sharing with third-party analytics providers?

Yes — we include an optional "Subprocessor & Analytics" clause (Section 4.3 in the sample DPA) that is opt-in. If MeadowBank wants no downstream analytics, we can remove or mark it as "disabled" in the drafted agreement. I’ve added a short doc note in the Drive folder. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqX-example-redwood-meadowbank

> SOC 2: we can sign a mutual NDA. If you can send the NDA template or link, procurement will route it.

Attached is our standard Mutual NDA template (we’ll provide a link if you prefer DocuSign). Once signed, we’ll share the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted).

Proposed next step: 30-min call to walk the questionnaire and confirm Module B choices — I’m proposing Tue 24 Nov at 10:00 AM PT. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite with the questionnaire attached.

Forwarding the exact attachments referenced below.

Best,
Jonas
